description: Press at (x1, y1), drag to (x2, y2) and release, in a desktop capsule. Or draw along a path: path is a list of [x, y] points (at most 1000), pressed at the first and released at the last, for curves, circles, signatures and any shape a hand draws. smooth draws a curve through the points instead of straight lines; closed returns to the first point (eight points on a circle with smooth and closed make a round circle); stepMs is the pause between points (8 ms by default; apps such as Paint need about that to see every point). The button is honoured (right paints with Paint's second color).
